verdict.rationale: New Relic documents AI-powered summaries of workload health/performance trends (new-relic-docs-43) and a conversational AI assistant that helps troubleshoot issues and explore telemetry (new-relic-docs-9, new-relic-docs-10), which is adjacent to incident summarization for responders, but no docs explicitly describe AI-generated incident summaries or alert-context write-ups delivered to on-call responders. Missing for 10: explicit incident/alert AI-summary feature (e.g., auto-generated incident postmortems or alert enrichment for responders), and independent/hands-on validation of such a feature.
